Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionRun a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate. The Walking Trade is a quirky, action-packed zombie apocalypse store management game where chaos and commerce collide! Design your shop, balancing space, aesthetics, and functionality. Organize shelves, set prices, and ensure customers leave happy - or at least alive. Customers aren’t your only problem - zombies invade! Wield melee weapons, firearms, or whatever you can find to defend your shop during raids and hordes. Hire survivors to scavenge supplies, serve customers, or guard the shop. Keep them equipped and motivated to reap the rewards. Unlock crafting stations to create weapons, tools, and shop upgrades. Build barricades, storage units, and even makeshift traps to keep zombies at bay. Be a benevolent shopkeeper or an opportunistic overlord. Help the community, price gouge, or even sabotage settlements for profit. Your reputation determines who comes knocking. In The Walking Trade, every decision shapes your survival. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionOne day, a mysterious unit attacked the base of Slash Unit, who had been training to become the pilots of Vectors. But who are they…? Now, the battle begins again, with the secrets lie hidden! This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units. 16 different levels of pure tactical strategy. Features: * Strategic Freedom: Assign any VECTOR to any character. * Permadeath: Mistakes are permanent. Command wisely. * Narrative Decisions: Trust no one. Learn the truth through survival. * Gallery: view images from the original game’s illustrations, posters, box design, etc. * Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up * Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.) * Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point * Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)Show morePublished byRatalaika Games S.L.Developed byRatalaika GamesPlay withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SCapabilities4K Ultra HDSingle playerOptimized for Xbox Series X|SSmart DeliveryXbox achievementsXbox presenceXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
